description: An earlier Qwen parameter scan with a shrimp-shaped island of repeating behavior inside irregular response regions. The image has no overlaid communication addresses. It is reproduced unchanged as background context.

scope: Reproduced without modification from the earlier Qwen feedback study: a parameter scan of the period-six shrimp. This image supplies dynamical context, not a new measurement of channel reliability or memory capacity.
uncertainty: Reproduced raster; no new uncertainty or measurement inferred.
accessibility: Direct text labels and values; meanings do not rely only on color. PNG plots also have scalable SVG and PDF counterparts.
